PATTERN: Build large Swift codebases with parallel agents by assigning each agent exclusive file ownership

EXECUTION ORDER:
1. Stream 0 (foundation) runs FIRST — all shared models, protocols, constants (~20 files)
2. Streams 1-9 run simultaneously — each owns its own files, NEVER overlaps

STREAM SPLIT (used in Negotiation Trainer):
- Stream 1: Theme + shared components
- Stream 2: Content data (techniques, drills, scenarios)
- Stream 3: SwiftData persistence layer
- Stream 4: AI Service (Gemini)
- Stream 5: Scoring + progression logic
- Stream 6: Drill UI (all drill types)
- Stream 7: Scenario/chat UI
- Stream 8: Home + technique tree UI
- Stream 9: Profile, paywall, app shell

RESULT: 119 files, BUILD SUCCEEDED, 0 errors in one session

GOTCHA: Run xcodegen AFTER all agents complete — xcodegen picks up all Swift files from directory scan
